check_findings.meaning: Read-only display of existing check judgments. Decisive includes support or refutation, not source agreement or task completion. Internal checks do not add original units; no declared checks does not mean complete. Conditions and review qualifications remain in the evidence.

applicability.scope_rationale: Targeted follow-up to the preserved full numerical reproduction. E5 and residual periodic traces in F2a/F3a/F3b are covered, with four OBC positive controls. This is not a new whole-paper or whole-panel count.

result_summary.meaning: Task completion, source agreement and record integrity are separate. Conditional support describes applicability, not unfinished work. No source agreement is inferred from decisive-judgment counts or packaging.
